4d27f641193063a59f99.en: A sound source is anything that makes a sound.
4d27f641193063a59f99.id: Sumber bunyi (sound source) adalah apa saja yang menghasilkan bunyi.

7c25c729f6202dc26bc6.en: We hear sounds with our ears.

89a2c28cfdeaffe3b364.en: Some sounds are loud, like thunder. Some are quiet, like a whisper.
89a2c28cfdeaffe3b364.id: Ada bunyi yang keras (loud), seperti guntur. Ada juga yang pelan (quiet), seperti bisikan.

163c1ddc3a1155e51625.en: Sounds get quieter as you move further away.
163c1ddc3a1155e51625.id: Bunyi makin pelan saat kamu bergerak makin jauh.

2d12bf2cc65bd6c16592.en: Cover your ears near very loud sounds. This keeps them safe.
2d12bf2cc65bd6c16592.id: Tutup telingamu bila ada bunyi yang sangat keras. Ini menjaga telingamu tetap aman.
